lemma myRev_concat (a b : List α) : myRev (a ++ b) = myRev b ++ myRev a := by
  induction a generalizing b with

  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp [myRev, List.cons_append] at *
    rw [ih]
    <;> simp [myRev]

    rw [myRev, myRev_concat]

    <;> rw [ih]
